scope: Read-only exact helper source review; no Docker calls, network downloads or test execution.

findings.title: Diagnostic or persistence failure skips owned-container cleanup
findings.detail: Inside finally, state inspect/JSON/key projection and exclusive before-cleanup save precede kill/wait/rm in the same try. Any one of those throws directly to cleanupError, without attempting termination/removal of the already positively identified owned container. Reporting cleanup-unverified is honest but does not fulfill always-attempt-owned-cleanup lifecycle.
findings.requiredRepair: Track positive ownership independently; capture diagnostics/persistence errors without suppressing independent bounded terminate/remove attempts, then positive absence check. If create outcome is unknown, reconcile exact name+label before mutation; never remove a foreign container. Retain failed/unknown cleanup and do not advance to offline stage.
requiredChecks: Inject failed State inspection after owned container creation and verify independent cleanup attempts.
Inject before-cleanup persistence failure and verify independent cleanup attempts.
Preserve unknown ownership/no foreign removal and positive absence failure cases.

otherwiseReviewed: Fixed immutable ARM64 public image, explicit no implicit create pull, one create/start/commit intents, no guest developer configuration or host bind mounts.

APT signed index/authentication options retained; exact systemd package versions, print-URI authenticated size/hash budget, download-only followed by no-download installation, archive hash and exact-set closure.

512MiB/2CPU/128PID limits; archive/index/run tmpfs bounds; operation150s plus cleanup reserve30s. Network/disk watchdog is a sampled acceptance cap, not a hard byte quota, as packet explicitly states.
Setup image has no runtime/native qualification. Derived immutable image/actual package closure must be reviewed before separately bound offline systemd test.
Original base or preexisting images/containers are not deleted. Random name and source label are used for unknown-create ownership reconciliation.
limitations: Real availability, exact dependency download set, package install behavior and Docker cgroup capability remain unexecuted.
No paid action, native binary execution or Linux qualification granted.
